title: Coming Back
novel:
James, Barney's brother, arrived at the Farhampton Inn and [[revealed|reveal]] some shocking news. He was getting a [[divorce|divorce]] from his husband. Robin worried about how Barney would [[react|react]] to this news, since Barney always saw James's marriage as proof that true love could last.

Barney tried to act [[calm|calm]] at first, but he was deeply [[hurt|hurt]] inside. He questioned whether his own wedding would end the same way. Robin sat down with him and [[comforted|comfort]] him. She told him that their love was different and stronger.

Meanwhile, Marshall was still [[racing|race]] to the wedding. He and Daphne continued to [[argue|argue]] during the long drive. They could not agree on anything, from the radio station to the temperature in the car. Despite their differences, they slowly started to understand each other.

Ted arrived at the Farhampton Inn and found himself [[alone|alone]] in a very [[romantic|romantic]] hotel room. The room was decorated with roses and candles, which made him feel even more lonely. He missed his girlfriend who was far away.

Lily [[worried|worry]] about Ted being by himself. She invited him to join her for dinner, but Ted insisted he was fine. He spent the evening walking on the beach, thinking about his life and the changes that were coming.

By the end of the evening, Barney felt better after talking with Robin. He realized that love required effort and [[trust|trust]]. The group came together at the hotel bar, [[relieved|relieve]] that the first day of the wedding weekend was finally over.

reveal.en: He revealed the truth to his friends.

divorce.en: They decided to get a divorce after ten years.

react.en: She reacted calmly to the bad news.

calm.en: He stayed calm during the emergency.

race.en: He raced to the airport to catch his flight.

argue.en: The two brothers argued about everything.

alone.en: He lived alone in a big house.

romantic.en: They had a romantic dinner by the sea.

worry.en: She worried about her sick mother.

trust.en: Trust is important in a relationship.
